crossRefs.note: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and…
Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever…

translations.web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
translations.bsb: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
translations.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
translations.asv: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.
